title: Knocked up Argentinian shrimp Pasta
description: A sweet and springy weeknight Argentinian dish featuring clotted cream and shrimp, this pescatarian-friendly recipe is perfect for a quick dinner, made possible by pressure-cooking the shrimp and pasta together.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook until they turn pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
In a small bowl, whisk together the clotted cream, parmesan cheese, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Stir the cream mixture into the skillet with the shrimp and garlic.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss everything together until the pasta is well coated with the cream sauce.
Transfer the pasta and shrimp mixture to a pressure cooker and cook on high pressure for 5 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally for 5 minutes, then quick-release any remaining pressure.
Serve the pasta and shrimp hot, garnished with additional parmesan cheese if desired.
